stories.headline: Philippine VP Duterte’s impeachment nears end as prosecutors stake case on unexplained wealth
stories.standfirst: Prosecutors are focusing on alleged unexplained wealth as they seek to finish Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial before year-end. The outcome now rests with the Senate.

stories.headline: Eala ready to disappear for a bit after breakout season comes to an end
stories.standfirst: Alex Eala is taking a break after a breakthrough season and looking toward 2027. Hula’s next question: how far can she go at the Australian Open?

markets.question: Will the Senate convict VP Sara Duterte by 31 Dec 2026?
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if the Philippine Senate officially votes to convict Vice President Sara Duterte in an impeachment trial on or before 31 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. Philippine time. Otherwise resolves No, including acquittal, dismissal, or no conviction by the deadline. Only an official Senate verdict counts; statements, allegations, and predictions do not.
markets.resolutionSource: Senate of the Philippines · official verdict and records

markets.question: Will Alex Eala reach the Australian Open 2027 quarterfinals?
markets.shortQuestion: Eala to the Australian Open QF?
markets.rules: Resolves Yes if Alex Eala officially reaches the women’s singles quarterfinal round of the 2027 Australian Open, including advancement by walkover. Otherwise resolves No, including withdrawal or elimination before the quarterfinals. If the event is cancelled or the relevant results are unavailable by 31 January 2027, 11:59 p.m. Philippine time, this preview market is void and points are returned.
markets.resolutionSource: Australian Open · official women’s singles draw and results
